title: FinTech Payment Processing API
description: Designed and built a high-throughput REST API for a payment gateway, integrating with multiple banking providers and handling reconciliation pipelines.
details: Built on AWS Lambda with SQS for async job processing, supporting idempotent retries and dead-letter queues. Integrated with three banking provider SDKs behind a unified adapter pattern, reducing future integration effort. Implemented automated nightly reconciliation that cut manual finance team work by 80%.
